title: 꺼진 화면의 길
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, arpeggiated minor-key riff with light chorus and reverb. A sub-bass synth provides deep, sustained low-end notes. The percussion consists of a crisp electronic snare with a long reverb tail and a soft, rounded kick drum. A female vocalist sings in a breathy, intimate style, transitioning between a chest voice and a light falsetto. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. Subtle atmospheric synth pads provide harmonic depth in the background. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the rhythmic guitar pattern.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated clean electric guitar with chorus effect]
[sub-bass synth enters]
(Hmm-mm)

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
눈을 감으면 문이 보여 [soft electronic kick drum]
매일 밤 같은 문이야
손잡이를 돌리면 열려
그 안엔 네가 있었어 [reverberant snare hit]

복도 끝 흐린 빛 아래서
네 목소리가 들려와
이름을 부르는 것 같아
